items.headline: $PAPER Perps Launch Pulls $3B in Positions in First Hour
items.summary: New onchain perps venue Papertrade drew a reported $3B in positions within an hour of launch, with DefiLlama tracking $137M in trader balances and house liquidity. $PAPER stakers earn rewards funded by trader losses.

items.headline: $SUI Gains 54% in Four Weeks, Outpacing BTC and ETH
items.summary: $SUI rallied 54% over four weeks, beating Bitcoin and Ether, while its DeFi liquidity expanded more slowly. A recent pullback briefly interrupted the surge.

items.headline: $AERO Sets Oct. 21 Merger Launch and Token Conversion Terms
items.summary: Aerodrome's $AERO merger launches Oct. 21: $AERO converts one-for-one while $VELO converts at roughly 0.044 new $AERO per token, with existing locks keeping their duration.

items.headline: $PUMP.fun to Tie Callout Rewards to Followers' Profits
items.summary: Pump.fun will reward memecoin callouts based on followers' actual profits, with low-cap token shills earning less starting with the Oct. 10 payout, co-founder Alon said.

items.headline: Kalshi Probes Insider Bets on Trump Press Secretary Pick
items.summary: Kalshi is investigating three bets totaling about $173 placed before news of Trump's press secretary pick broke, set to pay out roughly $9,600 combined, per WSJ.
